conversion.initializationPolicy: Zero only ordinates in AMP pulses 1-3; preserve their time tokens and node counts. Pulses 4-10 and comparison/reference/amplitudes.txt remain unchanged.
conversion.timeGrid: Use the original input3XX/general.txt without numerical changes
conversion.approval: The copied _nogo.e3d is retained. Open the task in the editor, review model diagnostics and complete the normal save/validation action before native OM launch; do not delete the marker manually.

derivedReference.numericText: step, time_s and Current_A tokens copied verbatim without numeric reformatting

editorValidation.scope: Read-only load using real dataService.load, tabRegistry, modelValidator, material reference catalog and schema constraint checks. This does not perform a save or certify an OM numerical run.
loadWarnings: general.txt: legacy input omits useMED; the editor supplies its schema default in memory.
conrab.txt: legacy input omits GEO_ANGLE, CF_FMMEPS, CF_HTSEPS, fullJNewton; the editor supplies schema defaults in memory.
modelWarnings: Element rows 8 and 9: a local symmetry angle is redundant when no local images are enabled.
editorValidation.originalFilePolicy: Keep original field inputs byte-for-byte except for the working pulse preparation recorded under conversion; preserve comparison/reference/amplitudes.txt as the source. Editor save uses current schemas and may normalize legacy aliases, remove obsolete keys and persist defaults; retain this reference and inspect the saved inputs before comparison.
